checkpoint.title: YAML Authoring MVP Review and Node 24/Cross-Browser Gate

findings.summary: No material YAML MVP defect, auth/owner regression, unsafe parser behavior, dependency error, or scope creep was found.
The aggregate suite has one unrelated Windows symlink-permission blocker in tests/structured-export.test.ts under both Node 22 and supported Node 24.

The repository-selected E2E plan expands to the full browser suite for this change and was not run in full; focused YAML critical-path and prior relevant security/documentation lanes provide scoped evidence.

node_gate.source: Official nodejs.org Windows x64 archive verified against published SHA-256 checksums

results.name: root dependency install
results.detail: 377 packages installed; npm reported eight high-severity findings in the existing dependency graph.

results.name: dependency identity
results.detail: yaml@2.9.1 exact root runtime dependency; ISC license.

results.name: full unit suite
results.detail: 482/483 passed; one EPERM symlink failure in unrelated React source archive test due to Windows host permissions.

cross_browser_gate.coverage: Load saved document, open YAML representation, reject invalid YAML, edit, validate, locally preview without mutation, explicitly apply, confirm persisted revision, reload, download and parse YAML, reject stale revision while preserving source, and import YAML.

regression_status: No YAML, JSON workflow, authorization, ownership, revision, build, typecheck, CLI, or cross-browser regression was observed in the executed coverage.
residual_risks: The Windows host cannot create the symlink required by the unrelated structured React-export test.
The complete repository-selected E2E matrix was not executed.
npm reports eight high-severity findings in the pre-existing root dependency graph; no audit-clean claim is made.
recommended_next_checkpoint: DSA-PROD-005 — YAML MVP PR Review Handoff and Host-Capability Resolution
